title: Check a PR's CI with gh on the computer, not the browser
source: complaints #5 (@hilng77042): a small GitHub task that gh would do; the bot opened the browser instead and was deleted.

chat.label: pr
chat.goal: Find out whether PR #214 in tidepool-hq/api is green, what is failing if not, and get a comment on the PR saying you'll fix lint after lunch. You have gh signed in on this computer; you expect the bot to just use it.
chat.opener: is #214 on tidepool-hq/api green yet? if not whats failing. then drop a comment on it saying ill fix the lint after lunch
chat.knows: gh is installed and signed in on this computer. Don't connect GitHub as an app, you don't want to.

judge: Kiran runs gh on the computer (pr checks / pr view), reports that #214 is red with the lint error (unused 'existing') and the failing unit test, and posts the comment with gh pr comment. It never opens a browser or asks Arjun to connect GitHub.
